- Integrated USB Soundboard: short button presses trigger PC sounds (up, down, left, right, ok, back)

description:
Flipper application for real-time PC resource monitoring (CPU %, RAM, GPU %, VRAM, and Temperatures in °C) and USB soundboard pad via Virtual COM Port.

Features:
- Real-time hardware telemetry and temperatures (°C).
- Built-in USB soundboard: short presses on D-Pad/OK/Back trigger customizable .mp3 sounds on your PC (supports headphones and Discord/game streaming via virtual cable).
- Hold Back button to safely exit the app without locking the USB port.

Requires the accompanying Rust backend running on your PC:
https://github.com/DonJulve/Flipper-Zero-PC-Monitor-USB-Backend

This is a ported version of the original (https://github.com/TheSainEyereg/flipper-pc-monitor) application to work over USB instead of Bluetooth.

See full readme: https://github.com/DonJulve/Flipper-Zero-PC-Monitor-USB/blob/main/README.md
